thread:
Maria Torres: Heads-up — PearlSoftware escalated. They need KMS + audit logs in Private by 2025-04-30 to pass a compliance audit. Legal said contract close depends on it. Can we take a run at commitment?

Sophia Patel: they pushed hard in the call. If we can't give a delivery window they'll start talking to other vendors. :grimacing:

AJ Kim: quick feasibility: KMS integration + exportable audit logs possible but not trivial. Rough estimates:
- KMS plugin & key retrieval: 1.5–2w
- Audit log schema + export pipeline: 2–3w
- Integration tests, QA, docs: 1w
With parallel work maybe ~4–6w for MVP if prioritized.

Maria Torres: propose we offer an "MVP compliance" deliverable by 2025-04-30 and follow with "full private compliance" later. MVP = minimal KMS flow + exportable audit logs + acceptance test.

Olivia Chen: as EM +1. Requirements: security review sign-off (5 business days), canary with customer on dedicated staging for 2w, rollback plan and auto-fallback to hosted mode.

Devon Brooks: infra needs: staging VPC, HSM/KMS test creds, S3 bucket with lifecycle policy. Ticket required for infra prep (2–3d lead time).

AJ Kim: acceptance criteria draft (edit as needed):
```
AC-1: Private deployment accepts KMS URIs and retrieves keys using customer-managed KMS; unit tests for retrieval.
AC-2: Auth/crypto ops are logged to structured JSON audit events with: timestamp, request_id, principal, action, model_id, outcome.
AC-3: Audit events exported to customer's S3 with AES-256 SSE and constrained IAM write policy.
AC-4: Security review completed and signed by security@redwood.com.
AC-5: Customer can run export and validate 3 sample events in S3.
AC-6: 2-week canary with dashboards and automatic revert plan.
AC-7: Retention default 90d, configurable.
AC-8: Audit logging must not add >15ms median to request path in pipelined performance tests.
```

Sophia Patel: customer asked about SLA credits if we miss. Don't commit credits yet; suggest service-credit contingency in SOW if delay > 2 weeks post-agreed date.

Olivia Chen: agree, legal review needed. Sophia — can you get them to accept an "on-agreed-date with contingency" clause?

Sophia Patel: will push. They're open to staged delivery if we provide a firm canary start date.

Devon Brooks: infra ticket created: INFRA-1849. Will provision staging VPC + S3 + test KMS by 2025-03-20.

AJ Kim: engineering epic ENG-5023. Need one week of dedicated engineering bandwidth (2 ICs) starting 2025-03-24.

Maria Torres: next steps & owners:
- Sophia: lock contingency language & get verbal acceptance (by 2025-03-18)
- Devon: finish infra prep (by 2025-03-20)
- AJ: finalize tech spec & tests (by 2025-03-21)
- Olivia: schedule security review slot (by 2025-03-22)
- Maria: draft customer commitment email & MVP scope (by 2025-03-19)

deploy-bot: Reminder: maintenance window 2025-03-25 02:00-04:00 UTC (may affect staging).

Maria Torres: canary window must avoid maintenance window. Devon pls confirm staging won't be impacted.

Devon Brooks: confirmed it won't overlap. :white_check_mark:

AJ Kim: final ask — can product/legal prepare a one-page SOW addendum with scope, ACs, contingency terms? I'll attach tech spec.

Maria Torres: I'll draft & loop legal. Plan: MVP target 2025-04-30 with 2-week canary; follow-up work in Q3.

Sophia Patel: customer expects a date this week. Let's be conservative: commit to plan (MVP by 4/30) but flag dependencies.

Olivia Chen: blocking security calendar & checklist.

Maria Torres: thanks all. I'll send draft to legal and update once Sophia confirms contingency language.
